definition: to start a new account with a bank
example: Newcomers can open an account with just a passport and their PR card.

definition: a bank account used for everyday payments and spending
vi: tài khoản thanh toán (tài khoản chi tiêu hằng ngày)
example: My pay goes into my chequing account, and I transfer some to savings each month.

definition: a bank account that pays interest on money you keep there
example: A high-interest savings account is a safe place for your emergency fund.
collocations: put money in a savings account

definition: to take money out of a bank account
example: You can withdraw cash from any of our ATMs without paying a fee.

definition: to put money into a bank account
example: You can make a deposit by taking a photo of the cheque in the banking app.
collocations: make a deposit at the ATM

definition: a quick way to send money to someone by email or phone in Canada
example: My roommate sends me his share of the rent by e-transfer on the first of every month.

definition: money a bank charges each time you make a payment or withdrawal
example: Using another bank's ATM usually means paying an extra transaction fee.

definition: when you spend more money than is in your account, borrowing from the bank
vi: tình trạng thấu chi (rút/chi quá số dư tài khoản)
example: I was charged a fee because the payment put my account into overdraft.

definition: a number that shows how reliable you are at paying back money
example: Paying your bills on time is the best way to build a good credit score in Canada.

definition: the maximum amount you can spend on a credit card
example: The bank raised my credit limit after I'd had the card for a year.

definition: the percentage charged for borrowing money or paid for saving it
example: The Bank of Canada lowered its interest rate, which made mortgages slightly cheaper.

definition: a loan from a bank used to buy a home
vi: khoản vay thế chấp mua nhà
example: Our mortgage payments went up by $400 a month when we renewed at a higher rate.

definition: to formally ask a bank to lend you money
example: To apply for a loan, you'll need your recent pay stubs and two pieces of ID.
collocations: apply for a small business loan

definition: to finish paying all of a debt
example: Once we pay off our car loan, we will have more money for travel.
collocations: pay off the balance in full

definition: to owe money to someone
example: Many students can expect to be in debt for years after graduation.
collocations: be in debt to the bank

definition: to spend only the amount of money you planned
vi: chi tiêu đúng theo ngân sách đã định
example: If you stick to a budget, you can save for a vacation without using credit cards.
collocations: find it hard to stick to a budget
set a budget and stick to it

definition: to keep money over time in order to buy something
example: We rarely eat out because we want to save up for a down payment.

definition: to have enough money to pay for something
vi: có đủ khả năng chi trả
example: Many young families can no longer afford a detached house in Vancouver.

definition: money spent on something
example: I track all my monthly expenses in a spreadsheet, from groceries to car insurance.

definition: a document that lists goods or services provided and how much must be paid
example: Please pay the invoice within 30 days of receiving it.

definition: the amount of money currently in a bank account
example: I check my account balance on the app before making large purchases.

definition: a record from the bank listing all money in and out of an account
example: The landlord asked for three months of bank statements to prove my income.

definition: a payment from your account that you did not approve
vi: giao dịch trái phép, giao dịch không được phép
example: I called the bank immediately when I noticed an unauthorized transaction on my credit card.

definition: a payment made electronically straight into someone's bank account
vi: chuyển khoản trực tiếp vào tài khoản (lương, trợ cấp)
example: Set up direct deposit so your tax refund arrives faster.

definition: a professional who helps people plan how to save and invest money
example: Our financial advisor suggested we put more into our RRSPs before the contribution deadline.

definition: money put aside to live on after you stop working
example: Many Canadians worry that their retirement savings won't be enough.

definition: a payment made after the due date
example: A late payment can hurt your credit score and add interest charges.

definition: the smallest amount you must pay on a credit card bill each month
example: If you only make the minimum payment, it can take years to clear your balance.
collocations: pay more than the minimum payment

definition: a regular payment taken automatically from your account with your permission
vi: thanh toán tự động đã được ủy quyền trước
example: I pay my hydro bill through a pre-authorized payment, so I never miss a due date.

definition: the amount of money needed to pay for basic things like housing and food
example: The high cost of living in Metro Vancouver is pushing some families to move to Alberta.
